items.q: He looked like Stuff Smith, and he played just like Stuff Smith.

ctx.x: And we organized a jazz -- jazz chapter in-- That's when Jazz started to catch over in Norway.

Now, there was a man, fellow named Sven Asmussen, come from Denmark. He looked like Stuff Smith, and he played just like Stuff Smith. He was a Dane, the swingingest rascal you ever heard. On the violin.
Oh, you mean after Stuff Smith?
